label: A power for there being no contingent concretum issues in a world where its holder exists
paraphrase: OPEN (P2, initiator presence; analyst reconstruction): whatever has at w a power for there being no contingent concrete being can exercise it so that, at some world accessible from w, there is no contingent concrete being and the holder exists there. With the frame's tenseless world-relative existence, the initiator of a chain exists in the world of that chain. Close to the premise of Pruss's sketch that x cannot start a chain of causes leading to actuality's not including x (navigation only, not attributed); under a tensed reading (absence at the end of a history) a self-annihilating holder falsifies it (controls, Pruss omission 2).
